title: 情報通信システム
subtitle: Communication Network Systems
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) understand basic communication and network systems.
(2) learn configurations of communication network.
(3) learn wired and wireless communication systems such as optical fiber and mobile communication systems.
(4) learn data communication based on computer network systems.
advice:
This is a fundamental course of communication and network systems.

1. Historical review of communication and network systems
2. Wired communication
3. Wireless communication
4. Data communication
5. Fundamental technology of communication systems

This course is related with other subjects such as "Transmission of Electronic Information", "Communication Engineering", "Electromagnetic Wave Engineering" and "Network Technology of Information and Communication". Students will learn elemental technologies in the related subjects, since communication and network system consists of widely rage of technology.
books:

requiredKnowledge: Ask questions positively, if students do not understand enough. Students will learn related things of internet in "Network Technology of Information and Communication".
